items.source: Create a new TransactionAwareCacheManagerProxy, setting the target CacheManager through the setTargetCacheManager(CacheManager) bean property.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `TransactionAwareCacheManagerProxy`，通过 `setTargetCacheManager(CacheManager)` 属性设置目标 `CacheManager`。

items.source: Proxy for a target CacheManager, exposing transaction-aware Cache objects which synchronize their Cache.put(Object, Object) operations with Spring-managed transactions (through Spring's TransactionSynchronizationManager), performing the actual cache put operation only in the after-commit phase of a successful transaction. If no transaction is active, Cache.put(Object, Object) operations will be performed immediately, as usual.
items.translation: 目标 `CacheManager` 的代理，提供事务感知的 `Cache` 对象，这些对象将其 `Cache.put(Object, Object)` 操作与 Spring 管理的事务同步（通过 Spring 的 `TransactionSynchronizationManager`），仅在成功事务的提交后阶段执行实际的缓存写入操作。如果没有活动事务，则像往常一样立即执行 `Cache.put(Object, Object)` 操作。

items.source: Create a new TransactionAwareCacheManagerProxy for the given target CacheManager.
items.translation: 为给定的目标 CacheManager 创建一个新的 TransactionAwareCacheManagerProxy。

configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
